description: This file defines the ImpactDataProjectTransformer class, responsible for transforming impact data related to projects, including formatting impact data IDs, estimations, data values, and generating project-specific impact data URLs.

classes.name: ImpactDataProjectTransformer
classes.description: A transformer class that prepares impact data from project models for external use, such as API response formatting.

methods.name: getImpactDataId
methods.description: Returns the title of the impact data associated with the model.

methods.name: getEstimation
methods.description: Returns the formatted estimation amount for the impact data.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Returns the impact data value along with its unit.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Generates URLs with project and impact data identifiers for related impact items.
